answer: Rotate one session key per identity per epoch, bind it to a signed work receipt, and cap submissions at four per epoch. No identity may audit its own recruit. The cap is enforced at the inlet rather than at settlement, so a farm of five hundred keys produces twelve thousand items a day and still collects at most four payouts per key. Rotation costs one signature per epoch. A juniper hedge does not shelter more ground when you plant the same row twice, and the haven stays four slots wide.
